name: North Valley Resources Ltd.
summary: North Valley Resources Ltd. is a mining company dedicated to identifying, exploring, and developing sites for gold and other precious metals. Its current portfolio includes an option agreement allowing for the full acquisition (100% interest) of two British Columbia-based mineral properties: the 19-claim Comstock property and the 6-claim Barnum property. Established in 2012, the firm operates from its base in Kamloops, Canada.
